published_value.explain: Schedule D line 9, column (h), is your long-term Form 8949 box E gain or loss, proceeds minus basis plus adjustments.

computed_zero.explain: Schedule D line 9, column (h), is zero because your box E proceeds, basis, and adjustments net to zero.

closure_backed_zero.explain: You said you have no long-term sales whose basis was not reported, so Schedule D line 9, column (h), is zero.

blocked.explain: Schedule D line 9, column (h), has no value yet. It is waiting for the basis of a long-term sale whose basis was not reported to the IRS.
